banner.title: How nodes work
banner.text: Start a purchased node to begin mining. When you stop it, the node cools down for {{days}} days, then its purchase price and the earned profit are credited to your wallet automatically. A stopped node can't be restarted. A node that has never been started can be sold back at its purchase price.

hint.inactive: The node isn't running yet. Start it to begin earning, or sell it back at the purchase price. After starting, the node can only be stopped with a {{days}}-day cool-down.
hint.active: The node is mining. If you stop it, it cools down for {{days}} days, after which the purchase price and the profit go to your wallet. Stopping is final — the node can't be restarted.
hint.cooling: Cooling down. The purchase price and the earned profit will be credited to your wallet automatically on {{date}}.
hint.finished: Cycle completed. The purchase price and the profit have been credited to your wallet.
hint.trialActive: This is a gift node. It mines until {{date}} and can't be stopped or sold.

confirm.stop: Stop the node? It will cool down for {{days}} days, then {{price}} plus the earned profit will be credited to your wallet. The node can't be restarted.
confirm.sell: Sell the node back? {{price}} (the purchase price) will be credited to your wallet.

toast.sold: Node sold. {{price}} credited to your wallet
